therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: aquaresis / free-water excretion reducing fluid overload
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with cardiac-induced edema (congestive heart failure)
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: change in body weight from baseline at Day 14 or final drug administration

results.effect_size: mean body weight change: -2.05 kg (stopped at end of Period 1), -1.31 kg (continued at 15 mg/day), -2.90 kg (dose escalated to 30 mg/day)
subgroup_findings: Subjects stopped at end of Treatment Period 1: mean weight change -2.05 kg
Subjects continued at 15 mg/day: mean weight change -1.31 kg
Subjects dose escalated to 30 mg/day: mean weight change -2.90 kg
safety_signals: Cardiac failure SAE in 1/13 subjects in the continued 15 mg/day group
Intracardiac thrombus SAE in 1/36 subjects in the stopped group
Cerebral artery embolism SAE in 1/36 subjects in the stopped group
Renal failure chronic SAE in 1/36 subjects in the stopped group

dose_info.dose_modifications: Dose escalation from 15 mg/day to 30 mg/day permitted based on response

results_by_chain.biology_description: aquaresis / free-water excretion reducing fluid overload
results_by_chain.population_description: patients with cardiac-induced edema (congestive heart failure)
